title: Understudy attention event v1 (REQ-8)
description: What a producer submits to POST /attention/events. A closed schema: a type from a closed enum, the person slug, an opaque subject id, an op, a few enums and small numbers. There is no free-text field. No screen, file, page, model or message text can pass through the attention layer, its store or its log. A value outside its enum or pattern is refused.

type.description: The kind of event. The router builds attention_digest itself; producers never submit it.

person.description: The engine's person slug, never a name. May instead be given as ?person= on the request.

subject.description: An opaque id naming what the event is about: the run, the queue item, the card, the Cue episode, the routine slug. Items with the same family and subject are one item.

op.description: resolve says the situation is over (an approval decided elsewhere, a run finished by itself, a card went stale): the item is dropped without bothering anyone.

t.description: When the reading was taken, the producer's clock (the freshness convention). Honoured only in mock mode (replays); a real server uses its own clock.

run_mode.description: Which kind of run: it names the source in the wording.

count.description: How many things this event stands for (cards, approvals, runs).

minutes.description: A duration, rounded to five minutes before it is worded.

expires_in_s.description: How long the event stays relevant. It may shorten the type's own expiry, never lengthen it.

deadline_in_s.description: Seconds until a calendar deadline (calendar_deadline only, required there). The item expires at the deadline.

blocks_run.description: A running job waits on this (an approval_waiting with blocks_run is treated as approval_blocking).

asked.description: The worker pressed for help (Cue). Only a cue can be asked for; quiet, budget and learning do not apply to it.

state.description: Optional fresh worker state for the admission decision, so a helpful-now event is judged on the worker as they are now.
